svg.title: Usama Faheem | Frontend-focused MERN Stack Developer
svg.desc: An animated terminal profile with a character-rendered portrait of Usama Faheem. Based in Lahore, Pakistan. React, Next.js, Node.js, Express and MongoDB. Selected work: SoftCr8ors, UK client websites, Shadab Rice and Reeba. Portfolio: usamafaheem.com.
